# Red River AI

> Custom AI automation for Manitoba and prairie businesses. n8n workflow automation, AI chatbots, social media AI, and 1-on-1 AI training. Prices posted.

Red River AI is based in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada. We build practical AI automations for small and medium businesses — no hype, just results. Run by Willy McKenzie: 18 years in programming, SQL, and cybersecurity; GIAC certified (GSEC, GCIH, GSOC).

## Services

- Workflow Automation: custom n8n workflows for invoicing, scheduling, data entry. If you do it by hand every week, we automate it.
- AI Chatbots: chatbots that answer questions, book appointments, and qualify leads 24/7.
- Social Media AI: content drafted, scheduled, and posted automatically across Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram.
- 1-on-1 AI Training: hands-on coaching for you or your team — prompting, n8n, automating your actual workflows. $200/session + tax.

## Pricing (CAD)

- Starter: $500 — 1 custom automation, built and launched.
- Growth: $1,000 — 3 automations. The usual pick.
- Enterprise: Custom — bigger systems, ongoing work.

## Service Area

Winnipeg, Brandon, Steinbach, and across Manitoba and the prairies.
